description: Implementation of the BankingService interface providing functionalities such as customer management, account operations, fund transfers, and transaction retrieval within a banking application.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing banking operations such as customer management, account handling, money transfer, and transaction retrieval, employing repository interactions and helper methods within a Spring framework context.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customers with their details.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds a customer by their customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information based on customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves account details for a given account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for an existing customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs a fund transfer between accounts for a specified customer.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Fetches all transactions associated with a specific account number.
